snippet.title: Do Not Kill Me Jacob!! - FULL PLAY + All endings (Visual Novel)
snippet.description:
Full play of the short visual novel game Do Not Kill Me Jacob!! You've been kidnapped by a serial killer, think you can talk your way out of being murdered? This Visual Novel was made for the O2A2 Jam! Features 3 endings + 1 secret ending. Created by Boredbradley.

Timestamps:
00:00 Start
00:15 Ending 1 Pleased Ending
04:00 Ending 2 Pissed Ending
06:18 Ending 3 Neutral Ending
08:46 Ending 4 Secret Ending

Credits:
Art by @Soundskies
Sound effects obtained from https://www.zapsplat.com
Music by Eric Matyas: www.soundimage.org

Did you enjoy Do Not Kill Me Jacob!!?

https://boredbradley.itch.io/dontkillmejacob
